provenance.source: Phase 4D BANC v888 node table (annotations only)

definitions.LEFT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'left' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.RIGHT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'right' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.UNASSIGNED: motor neurons not covered by LEFT, RIGHT or JUMP
definitions.ROLL: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
definitions.DUCK: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.overlap_policy: tergotrochanter candidates are also leg motor neurons; by default they are removed from LEFT/RIGHT so the action populations are disjoint and JUMP activity is not double-counted

unsupported_actions.ROLL: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
unsupported_actions.DUCK: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.scientific_status: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels derived from published effector annotations. They are not identified biological motor commands.

interface.activity_source: brain.neuron_model.LIFPopulation driven by an explicit experimenter current in the declared motor pools; no synapse and no graph edge is used
interface.decoder_input: spike times (ms) and graph node indices, the exact arrays stored by brain.neural_activity.SpikeRecorder; decode_recorder() accepts a SimulationResult.recorder directly

simulator_compatibility.conclusion: BrainSimulator.SynapseModel requires graph.vocabulary and graph.nt_code. BancConnectome provides neither, and Phase 4E deferred any transmitter sign policy, so the experiment injects current directly into the declared motor populations through the unmodified LIF model instead of forcing a full-network integration.

threshold_sensitivity.note: Phase 4D keeps every endpoint node at every threshold, so the annotation-derived masks are identical. The decoder never reads an edge, so a threshold cannot change a score; the threshold is recorded with every result and is never mixed.

limitations: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels from published effector annotations, not identified biological motor commands.
The tergotrochanter pool is a jump-associated candidate pool, not a validated jump command.
Activity comes from direct experimenter current into motor pools, not from synaptic propagation through the BANC connectome.
The core simulator cannot run on BancConnectome without a transmitter-sign and weight policy that this phase did not adopt.
All driven neurons share one current amplitude and one seeded jitter; the result says nothing about physiological motor coding.
No Subway Surfers action, keyboard output or game control is produced or claimed.
